plan.scope: Conditional buy/sell evaluation at identical recorded attention opportunities; not universe-selection evaluation.
plan.feature_scope: Frozen deployment mode: native weight-change features are zero, unlike online training. No claim of identical training feature distribution.
plan.timing: Inputs stop at the recorded applied-event cursor and observation_at; orders use the recorded later issuance time, preserving common inference latency.
plan.primary_selection: Latest completed checkpoint before cutoff; never select by returns
plan.tape_selection: First completed training episode that starts strictly after cutoff
